facts.text: The plot involves amnesiacs waking up in separate locations.
Yukiko wakes up first in an abandoned part of the tower basement.
Yukiko causes Takeshi's room to drop from the top of the tower.
Takeshi wakes up because his room drops from the top of the tower.
Yukiko and Takeshi do not remember anything.
Yukiko and Takeshi do not know their names.
Yukiko and Takeshi are instructed to climb a tower where the Gladiators are by their inner demons.
The inner demons prompt the amnesiacs to demolish a slave encampment on the way to the tower.
The amnesiacs eliminate the encampment staff who were abusing the slaves.
The player is introduced to the secret protagonists' feral state.
Yukiko and Takeshi meet each other face to face for the first time at the top of the tower.
Yukiko and Takeshi have a flashback of fighting each other when they meet.
Yukiko and Takeshi do not completely understand the flashback.
Yukiko and Takeshi are in a lot of pain after the flashback.
Yukiko assumes Takeshi is the cause of her mental anguish.
Yukiko wants to avoid Takeshi.
Takeshi attacks Yukiko and wants answers.
Yukiko and Takeshi cause an explosion during their fight.
Yukiko and Takeshi slowly fight their way down the tower.
Yukiko makes evasive maneuvers during the fight.
Takeshi is described as a brute during the fight.
Yukiko tricks Takeshi and trips him over the edge of a nearby cliff.
Yukiko falls into the deepest part of the ravine after tripping Takeshi.
Takeshi falls to the deepest part of the Ravine.
Yukiko catches herself and does not fall very far.
Yukiko tries to go after Takeshi after falling.
Yukiko is too exhausted to go after Takeshi.
Yukiko falls into a nearby river.
Takeshi is set up to be found by the Renegades.
Yukiko is set up to be found by the Gladiators.
The first part ends with Yukiko and Takeshi falling unconscious in separate locations again.
Shortly after the amnesiacs fall unconscious, the organization cannot investigate because they do not want to expose themselves.
The organization wakes up the Gladiators and the Renegades to investigate the situation.
Each perspective starts with a cut scene explaining the character's experience in the Gladiator Trials.
Each perspective cut scene also explains the character's connection with the amnesiacs.
Because the amnesiacs are unplayable at this moment, players switch to Adelaide and Rhydderch depending on which amnesiac they chose to play as.
A cutscene explains Adelaide's and Rhydderch's experience in the trials.
A cutscene also explains Adelaide's and Rhydderch's childhood memory of their timetraveling hero.
Damjan and Damia are not present in this section.
Damjan and Damia are described as tamer twins who tame the amnesiacs' mental instabilities.
The organization waits for when the amnesiacs are found before waking up the tamer twins and deploying them into their respective teams.
After introductions, survivors normally choose which Platoon they want to be in and which people they want to work with.
Because some people are missing, the plot postpones Platoon choice and deploys everyone onto the field to find missing members.
This deployment becomes the tutorial to the six main characters.
Yukiko was intended to join the Renegades.
Takeshi was intended to join the Gladiators.
The intended separation is to separate Yukiko from Adelaide and Takeshi from Rhydderch.
Tamma is hoping they find Takeshi.
Yuudai is hoping to find Yukiko.
After fighting and searching, the Gladiators find Yukiko.
After fighting and searching, the Renegades find Takeshi.
Tamma and Yuudai say they found the wrong person.
Tamma and Yuudai insist they keep searching.
Tamma and Yuudai insist the person they are looking for is the opposite gender.
Adelaide and Rhydderch acknowledge the gender statement but are adamant they found the right person.
Adelaide and Rhydderch insist the amnesiac should receive medical assistance.
The amnesiac found is unconscious with possible brain damage.
The teams decide to keep searching at the insistence of Tamma and Yuudai.
Adelaide and Rhydderch are left behind with their respective amnesiac.
Francessca and Eugene are close with the amnesiacs before their amnesia.
Francessca and Eugene do not mistake Tamma and Yuudai for the mysterious friend from the gladiator trials.
Francessca, Adelaide, Eugene, and Rhydderch are separated from their respective groups.
Damjan and Damia are introduced while Francessca, Adelaide, Eugene, and Rhydderch are not present.
The two parties fully tend to their respective unconscious amnesiacs.
The two parties find evidence proving their amnesiac is the same person as their mysterious friend from the gladiator trials.
Yukiko has the bracelet Adelaide made for her before the end of the trials.
Takeshi has the same scarf cloak Rhydderch gave him.
The two parties analyze that their friend has sustained some form of brain trauma.
The two parties analyze that their friend may not remember things.
Platoon assignments are permanent.

events.text: Yukiko and Takeshi fight their way down the tower, then separate into unconscious states in different locations
After the amnesiacs fall unconscious, the organization wakes up the Gladiators and Renegades to investigate
events.date_hint: shortly after the amnesiacs fall unconscious

events.text: Players switch to Adelaide and Rhydderch for the secret perspectives after the cut scenes
Damjan and Damia are introduced later while Francessca, Adelaide, Eugene, and Rhydderch are still separated
Gladiators find Yukiko and Renegades find Takeshi after searching
Adelaide and Rhydderch are left behind with their respective unconscious amnesiac while Tamma and Yuudai insist on continued searching
Francessca, Adelaide, Eugene, and Rhydderch tend to their amnesiacs and find evidence linking them to the mysterious friend from the gladiator trials
